description: Generate domain ideas from a specific business, product, audience, or naming brief and pre-check availability across partner-appropriate TLDs. If the customer has not described the business or supplied a name, ask for that context first; do not invent a brief. Only present an idea as currently available when its check succeeded and the result explicitly says available; failed checks remain unverified.

partner_id.description: ESB partner id. Optional if ENCIRCA_MCP_DEFAULT_PARTNER_ID is set.

name: suggest_available_domains
